audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0..6].side are all flat 'Skill' placeholders while content win[0..5]='Xerath' and win[6]='Janna' already carry a real verdict per stage — the two layers disagree.
audit.why: content.whys and content.spikes give grounded, non-templated reasoning for exactly this split: Xerath is the lone damage source and out-ranges Janna's charging Q pre-6, but her R (Monsoon), permanent E shields and W (Zephyr) slows take over once she's itemized.
audit.corrected: Set phases[0..5].side to Xerath and phases[6].side to Janna, matching win[N], with .why rewritten to state the same reasoning (not a win[N] edit needed since win[N] already matches the target side).

audit.why: content.spikes already correctly identifies level 2 W point, level 6 dual ults, and 1st item as the spikes.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit despite Howling Gale having a flat 14s cooldown.
audit.why: Q (Howling Gale) is 14s at all ranks per enemyKit.
audit.corrected: Added the 14s cooldown and Xerath's R cooldown to breakdown.cooldowns.

edits.after: You're the only damage source — Q outranges her charging tornado.

edits.before: W joins: the artillery circles tax the lane's geometry.
edits.after: W zone and poke punish her shield-only enchanter kit.

edits.after: Standing in range while Eye Of The Storm's (W) shield is still up on her target.
